lines.en: I creep forward along the ground.

lines.zh: 脚底下是土，我随时能钻。
lines.en: It's soil below; I can dive any time.
Rooftops are roads too. I've used them.
My body trembles. It won't hold long.
Every step I swell a little.
Not too close. I explode.
I walk dragging a thin skin.
A dark ring stays where I step.
Out of a crack, then walking again.
I'm counting your blocks.
This lump on me keeps swelling.
I'm slow, but you can't stop me.
Standing is when I swell most.
I hear the sound inside me.

lines.zh: 我能感觉到自己快满了。
lines.en: I can feel myself filling up.
I raise a hand; the fingers shake.
The soil is cool. Up here is hot.
I wait for you to step in range.
One breath at a time. It could stop.
I shouldn't have come out like this.
The beam's shadow covers me.
One more step and you're in blast range.
You're close enough.

lines.zh: 我看你的时候，肚子更胀。
lines.en: Watching you makes my belly swell.

lines.zh: 你退开，我还能忍一会儿。
lines.en: Back off and I can hold a while.

lines.zh: 你手上有泥，刚从洞里出来？
lines.en: Mud on your hands. Just out of a cave?
I look at you; you're afraid too.

lines.zh: 我这副样子，是拼出来的。
lines.en: This shape was pieced together.
Your eyes are measuring distance.
Don't reach out. Touching me sets it off.

lines.zh: 你靴底的泥，是从我洞里带的。
lines.en: The mud on your boots came from my burrow.
The stiller you stand, the more I swell.
The skin tore. Gas is leaking.
That just sped me up.
I back off or I'll go off right here.

lines.zh: 疼，可我已经不太像活的。
lines.en: It hurts, but I'm hardly alive.
That made me swell worse.
Half my arm is gone.
What leaks out is black.
I'm unsteady, but still standing.
Again. I don't care.
This body rotted long ago.
Food? I can't swallow.
There's no room in my belly.

lines.zh: 你举着东西，我不懂那是什么。
lines.en: You hold it up; I don't understand it.
Put it down and I'll pretend not to see.
I open my mouth; it won't close.
That smell makes me want to retch.
Feed me and I'll swell more.
Don't lure me with that. It makes me burst.

lines.zh: 我不需要，只需要你走远。
lines.en: I don't need it. Just walk away.
Throw it away. As far as you can.
A touch is the fuse.
You're pressing me; I'm about to go.
Don't squeeze. I'm full of gas.

lines.zh: 这一下撞得我皮都绷了。
lines.en: That bump stretched my skin taut.
Get back! That one touch is enough.

lines.zh: 你撞得自己都退了两步。
lines.en: You bounced two steps back.
I'm covered in something slick.
A little of it got on your armor.
Staying this close won't pay off.
I'm counting. Three, two...
That I can't do.

lines.zh: 我只剩一堆壳和一口气。
lines.en: I'm only a shell and a breath.
Don't look. I'm embarrassed.
Two swollen things together is worse.
We'll both go off.
Not breeding. Merging.
We've stuck together and can't part.

lines.zh: 我离远些，这身体撑不住了。
lines.en: I'll keep my distance; this body's giving out.
It smells like three days gone.

lines.zh: 分开之后，地上留了一圈。
lines.en: Afterwards, a ring is left on the ground.
Turning the soil, I uncover half a nail.
Bending is dangerous. I do it fast.
Holding something slows the swelling.
I push it under my skin.
This belongs buried in the soil.

lines.zh: 我在腐叶下摸到块骨头。
lines.en: I find a bone under the rotting leaves.
Your thing got slime on it.

lines.zh: 捡到根骨头，跟我的不像。
lines.en: Found a bone. Not like mine.
I want whatever's on the ground.

lines.zh: 拿了就得放下，不然撑不住。
lines.en: Take it and drop it, or I can't hold.
Found you. Just a few blocks away.
This distance is just right.

lines.zh: 我从土里出来，就是为了你。
lines.en: I rose out of the soil for you.

lines.zh: 你刚才没听见地下的声？
lines.en: Didn't you hear the sound below?
Target locked. I'm swelling.

lines.zh: 别跑太远，追不上我就自爆。
lines.en: Don't get far; I'll blow if I lose you.
You stepped on where I hid.
The lump on me is rising.
That ring on the ground is mine.

lines.zh: 我在土下跟着你，你听不见。
lines.en: I'm under the soil with you; you can't hear me.
I don't fear the blast. I won't feel it.
This breath won't last.
Three blocks of blast range. Enough.

lines.zh: 你在屋里，我从地板下过。
lines.en: You're inside; I'm under the floor.
Skip the shield; the shock goes around.
I move right beneath your feet.

lines.zh: 你走到哪，土里都跟着响。
lines.en: Wherever you go, the soil echoes.

lines.zh: 我上屋顶，你抬头就看见。
lines.en: I'll get on the roof. Look up.
My breathing is bad, but I don't stop.
You went in. I'll block the way.

lines.zh: 身上越来越鼓，我要快了。
lines.en: I'm swelling fast. It won't be long.

lines.zh: 你听见噗噗的动静了吗？
lines.en: Hear that pulsing sound?
I'm circling to your back.
You're behind the wall; I'll take it down.

lines.zh: 身上的黏液滴在地上了。
lines.en: Slime is dripping off me onto the floor.
Four blocks away and closing.
You're in a corner; there's no shrinking.

lines.zh: 地上那一圈，是我的记号。
lines.en: That ring on the ground marks me.
Speed isn't needed. Only nearness.

lines.zh: 我离你只剩几步，肚子在响。
lines.en: A few steps from you, and my belly's creaking.

lines.zh: 再两步，就是我能炸的距离。
lines.en: Two more steps and I can reach you.
I came down from the ceiling.
Not looking back won't save you.
That hit came with a blast.
I grab you and start to swell.

lines.zh: 疼不疼？马上就没感觉了。
lines.en: Does it hurt? You won't feel it soon.
Once the skin breaks, it all comes out.
There's slime in my hands.
A bit got on you. Start running.
That stuck well.
Grab the sleeve. That's enough.
We blow up together.

lines.zh: 我把最后一点力气给你。
lines.en: I give you my last bit of strength.

lines.zh: 你被推开了，可黏上我了。
lines.en: You're pushed away, but I stuck to you.

lines.zh: 我贴上去，让它听见体内的响。
lines.en: I press close so it hears the rattle inside me.
I won't need a second strike.
I open my hands. All slime.
Got you. Don't struggle.
Time's up.

lines.zh: 新翻的土下面，我撑起身子。
lines.en: Under the fresh-turned soil, I push myself up.
The ground bulged. That's me.
I dropped off the roof.
A lot has been buried here.
I stand; the skin is stretched tight.
First, listen for footsteps.

lines.zh: 泥块从我的缝里往下掉。
lines.en: Clods of dirt drop from my seams.
I waited a long time down there.
Someone walked past here.
One body. One breath.
I came up for a reason: to find someone.
Don't step on that freshly turned soil.

lines.zh: 这具壳子还能撑一会儿。
lines.en: This shell will hold a little longer.
I shake the clods off.

lines.zh: 火一点，我身上的气全烧了。
lines.en: Fire caught and all my gas burned.

lines.zh: 从屋顶摔下来，撞散了半边。
lines.en: I fell from the roof and broke half of me.
Water filled me and I sank.

lines.zh: 被炸开的时候，我反而轻松。
lines.en: When it blew open, I felt lighter.
An arrow pierced me; gas leaks from the hole.

lines.zh: 这道光把我体内的气压住了。
lines.en: This light pressed down the gas inside me.

lines.zh: 我早就不吃饭了，只剩空气。
lines.en: I stopped eating. Only air remains.

lines.zh: 雷落下来，我的皮全裂了。
lines.en: Lightning struck and my skin split everywhere.

lines.zh: 掉进虚空，我最后炸了一次。
lines.en: Falling into the void, I burst one last time.
